text: Execution order: claim calibration is Stage 0. Gates 1 (rsatoolbox parity), 2 (one-plan decomposition family), and 5 (large-q query-first) are the first parallel evidence tranche. Gate 3 consumes the already-implemented unequal-axis engine but is blocked on the existing public-example bead. Gate 4 is blocked on the existing conservation-precondition correction. The failure gallery consumes the existing planted-effect/negative-null evidence. Final manuscript and README promotion is blocked by every gate. Existing correlation policy, question-first onboarding, and map-scale gates remain the current response to the original three adoption risks; the open adoption-readiness epic bd-01M001NTCE1NPPFR8HW0T35TY5 retains unfinished onboarding and per-path reconciliation.
